verses.pali: Yopi hetu yopi paccayo cakkhussa uppādāya, sopi dukkho.
verses.english: The cause and reason that gives rise to the eye is also suffering.

verses.pali: Dukkhasambhūtaṁ, bhikkhave, cakkhu kuto sukhaṁ bhavissati …pe…
verses.english: Since the eye is produced by what is suffering, how could it be happiness?

verses.pali: Yopi hetu, yopi paccayo jivhāya uppādāya, sopi dukkho.
Dukkhasambhūtā, bhikkhave, jivhā kuto sukhā bhavissati …pe…
Yopi hetu yopi paccayo manassa uppādāya, sopi dukkho.
verses.english: The cause and reason that gives rise to the mind is also suffering.

verses.pali: Dukkhasambhūto, bhikkhave, mano kuto sukho bhavissati.
verses.english: Since the mind is produced by what is suffering, how could it be happiness?
They understand: ‘… there is nothing further for this place.’”
